blocks.title: Choke
blocks.text: Choke moti copper wire (taar) ki coil hai jo soft iron ke laminated core (patli patli tahon wala naram lohe ka core) par bohat se turns (chakkar) qareeb qareeb laga kar lapeti jati hai.

Choke ko aksar series RL circuit samjha jata hai: bohat kam resistance wala resistor R, aur bohat bari inductive reactance X_L = 2πfL wala inductor L, dono series mein (Fig. 17.7(e) kitab mein choke ki tasveer hai). Lohe ke core ki permeability (magnetic field ko guzarne dene ki capacity, salahiyat) zyada hai, is liye choke ki inductance L bohat zyada hoti hai. Resistance R bohat kam hai, is liye choke ka power factor (cos θ) taqreeban zero hai, yani current aur voltage ka phase difference θ taqreeban 90° hai. Is liye choke practically (amalan) koi power heat (garmi) mein waste (zaya) nahi karta. Choke zyada frequency wale AC ko rokta hai aur DC aur kam frequency wale AC ko guzarne deta hai. Is liye electronic circuits se zyada frequency ka AC noise (shor) filter kar (chhaant kar) saaf DC output dete hain. Switch-mode power supplies mein bhi zaroori hain: voltage ko regulate (qaboo) karte hain aur switching ka noise nikalte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai 'inductance X_L = 2πf L'. X_L = 2πfL coil ki inductive reactance (ohm mein) hai, inductance nahi; inductance L hai (henry mein).

Choke coils circuits se unwanted (na-chahe) RF (radio frequency) signals bahar nikalne nahi dete aur doosre sensitive (hassas) parts ko protect karte (bachate) hain. Fluorescent tube light mein choke transient voltage (achanak tez voltage) paida karta hai jis se tube ke andar gas breakdown ho kar roshan ho jati hai. Choke current ke achanak badalne ke rate ko bhi limit (had mein) rakhta hai, jis se surge ki wajah se insulation kharab nahi hoti.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
Capacitor aur inductor AC aur DC ke saath alag alag kyun behave (bartao) karte hain?
DC supply mein f = 0 hai, is liye X_L = 2πfL = 0: inductor DC ke liye conductor ki tarah hai.
DC supply (f = 0) mein X_C = 1/(2πfC) = 1/0 = ∞: capacitor DC ko rok deta hai lekin AC ko guzarne deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box mein 'For AC supply when f = 0' likha hai. f = 0 ka matlab DC hai, is liye sahi 'DC supply jab f = 0' hai. Is waqt X_C = ∞ aur capacitor DC ko rokta hai.

blocks.alt: Reactance X (ohm) aur frequency f ka graph. Blue seedhi lakeer XL = 2 pi f L zero se frequency ke saath barhti hai. Red lakeer XC = 1/(2 pi f C) frequency barhne par girti hai aur frequency zero ki taraf jane par bohat zyada (infinity ki taraf) oopar jati hai.
blocks.caption: Frequency ke muqable inductive aur capacitive reactance (is lesson ke liye original graph; kitab mein yeh graph nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh graph kitab mein nahi, samajhne ke liye hai. f = 0 (DC) par X_L = 0, is liye inductor DC ko aasani se guzarta hai; X_C infinite (la-mehdood, ∞) hai, is liye capacitor DC ko rok deta hai. Frequency barhne par X_L barhti hai aur X_C ghatti hai.

blocks.prompt: Choke current ko kam karta hai, phir bhi bohat kam power kharch kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki resistance bohat kam hai, is liye power factor taqreeban zero hai (V aur I mein taqreeban 90° ka farq). Choke current ko reactance se rokta hai, aur reactance energy ko heat banane ke bajaye store kar ke wapas kar deti hai.

items: Choke: laminated soft iron core par moti copper wire ke bohat se turns; R bohat kam, X_L bohat zyada.
Power factor taqreeban zero: taqreeban koi heat nahi.
Zyada frequency ka AC rokta hai; uses (istemal): filters, SMPS, RF rokna, tube light.
